name: Button
doc: Ttk Button widget, displays a textual label and/or image, and evaluates a command when pressed. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Button and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: invoke
doc: Invoke the command associated with the button and return its result.

name: Checkbutton
doc: Ttk Checkbutton widget, used to control a boolean variable that is toggled on and off. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Checkbutton and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: invoke
doc: Toggle the button between its selected and deselected states, invoke the command associated with the button, and return its result.

name: current
doc: If newindex is specified, sets the combobox value to the element position newindex. Otherwise, returns the index of the current value or -1 if the current value is not in the values list.

name: get
doc: Returns the current value of the combobox.

name: set
doc: Sets the value of the combobox to value.

name: Entry
doc: Ttk Entry widget, displays a one-line text string and allows the user to edit it. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Entry and inherits the common widget methods from Widget as well as the editing methods from tkinter.Entry.

name: bbox
doc: Return a tuple (x, y, width, height) giving the bounding box of the character at the given index.

name: identify
doc: Return the name of the element under the point given by x and y, or the empty string if no element is present at that location.

name: validate
doc: Force validation of the entry and return True if validation succeeded, and False otherwise.

name: Frame
doc: Ttk Frame widget, a container used to group and lay out other widgets. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Frame and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: Label
doc: Ttk Label widget, displays a textual label and/or image. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Label and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: LabeledScale
doc: A Frame containing a Scale and a Label that shows the scale’s current value. variable is the IntVar tracked by the scale (one is created if it is not given), and from_ and to define the range of the scale.

name: destroy
doc: Destroy this widget and remove the trace callback registered on the associated variable.

name: LabelFrame
doc: Alias of Labelframe, kept for naming compatibility with tkinter.LabelFrame.

name: Labelframe
doc: Ttk Labelframe widget, a container that draws a border and a title label around its contents. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.LabelFrame and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: Menubutton
doc: Ttk Menubutton widget, displays a textual label and/or image, and pops up a menu when pressed. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Menubutton and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: add
doc: Adds a new tab to the notebook.

name: enable_traversal
doc: Enable keyboard traversal for a toplevel window containing this notebook.

name: forget
doc: Removes the tab specified by tab_id, unmaps and unmanages the associated window.

name: hide
doc: Hides the tab specified by tab_id.

name: identify
doc: Returns the name of the tab element at position x, y, or the empty string if none.

name: index
doc: Returns the numeric index of the tab specified by tab_id, or the total number of tabs if tab_id is the string “end”.

name: insert
doc: Inserts a pane at the specified position.

name: select
doc: Selects the specified tab_id.

name: tab
doc: Query or modify the options of the specific tab_id.

name: tabs
doc: Returns a tuple of windows managed by the notebook.

name: OptionMenu
doc: Ttk OptionMenu widget, a Menubutton that pops up a menu of mutually exclusive choices. variable is the variable that tracks the currently selected value, default is the value to set initially, and values are the entries to display in the menu. A command keyword argument may be given to specify a callable that is invoked with the selected value whenever the selection changes; the style keyword argument sets the style used by the underlying menubutton; the direction keyword argument sets where the menu is posted relative to the menubutton (one of 'above', 'below' (the default), 'left', 'right' or 'flush'); and the name keyword argument sets the Tk widget name.

changed.text: Added support for the name keyword argument.

name: destroy
doc: Destroy this widget and its associated menu.

name: set_menu
doc: Replace the entries of the menu with values. If default is given, also set it as the current value of the variable.

name: PanedWindow
doc: Alias of Panedwindow, kept for naming compatibility with tkinter.PanedWindow.

name: Panedwindow
doc: Ttk Panedwindow widget, displays a number of subwindows stacked either vertically or horizontally. The user may adjust the relative sizes of the subwindows by dragging the sash between panes. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.PanedWindow and inherits the common widget methods from Widget, as well as the add() and panes() methods from tkinter.PanedWindow.

name: forget
doc: Remove child, which may be either an integer index or the name of a managed subwindow, from the panes.

name: insert
doc: Insert a pane containing child at the position pos. pos is either the string 'end', an integer index, or the name of a managed subwindow. If child is already managed by the paned window, move it to the specified position. Any keyword arguments set pane options.

name: pane
doc: Query or modify the options of the specified pane, where pane is either an integer index or the name of a managed subwindow. If no arguments are given, return a dictionary of the pane option values. If option is specified, return the value of that option. Otherwise, set the options given as keyword arguments to their corresponding values.

name: sashpos
doc: If newpos is specified, set the position of sash number index and return its new position. This may adjust the positions of adjacent sashes to ensure that positions are monotonically increasing; positions are also constrained to be between 0 and the total size of the widget. If newpos is omitted, return the current position of the sash.

name: start
doc: Begin autoincrement mode: schedules a recurring timer event that calls Progressbar.step() every interval milliseconds. If omitted, interval defaults to 50 milliseconds.

name: step
doc: Increments the progress bar’s value by amount.

name: stop
doc: Stop autoincrement mode: cancels any recurring timer event initiated by Progressbar.start() for this progress bar.

name: Radiobutton
doc: Ttk Radiobutton widget, used as part of a group to control a single shared variable by selecting one of several mutually exclusive values. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Radiobutton and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: invoke
doc: Set the option variable to the button’s value, select the button, invoke the command associated with the button, and return its result.

name: Scale
doc: Ttk Scale widget, displays a slider that lets the user select a numeric value from a range by moving the slider along a trough. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Scale and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: configure
doc: Modify or query the widget options, like Widget.configure. In addition, this method clips the from and to values so that the current value stays within the range defined by them.

changed.text: Now returns the configuration value, like Widget.configure.

name: get
doc: Return the current value of the scale. If x and y are given, return the value corresponding to the pixel coordinate x, y instead.

name: Scrollbar
doc: Ttk Scrollbar widget, controls the viewport of an associated scrollable widget such as a Treeview, Entry or tkinter.Text. It is the themed counterpart of tkinter.Scrollbar and inherits the common widget methods from Widget, as well as the set() and get() methods from tkinter.Scrollbar.

name: Separator
doc: Ttk Separator widget, displays a horizontal or vertical separator line. It has no direct counterpart in tkinter and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: Sizegrip
doc: Ttk Sizegrip widget, displays a grip that allows the user to resize the containing toplevel window by pressing and dragging the grip, typically placed in the bottom-right corner. It has no direct counterpart in tkinter and inherits the common widget methods from Widget.

name: Spinbox
doc: With a non-integer increment, see numeric values and the locale.

name: get
doc: Returns the current value of the spinbox.

name: set
doc: Sets the value of the spinbox to value.

name: Style
doc: This class is used to manipulate the style database.

name: configure
doc: Query or set the default value of the specified option(s) in style.

name: element_create
doc: Create a new element in the current theme, of the given etype which is expected to be either “image”, “from” or “vsapi”. The latter is only available in Tk 8.6 on Windows.

changed.text: Added support of the “vsapi” element factory.

name: element_names
doc: Returns a tuple of elements defined in the current theme.

name: element_options
doc: Returns a tuple of elementname’s options.

name: layout
doc: Define the widget layout for given style. If layoutspec is omitted, return the layout specification for given style.

name: lookup
doc: Returns the value specified for option in style.

name: map
doc: Query or sets dynamic values of the specified option(s) in style.

changed.text: The value returned when querying the map was corrected.

name: theme_create
doc: Create a new theme.

name: theme_names
doc: Returns a tuple of all known themes.

name: theme_settings
doc: Temporarily sets the current theme to themename, apply specified settings and then restore the previous theme.

name: theme_use
doc: If themename is not given, returns the theme in use. Otherwise, sets the current theme to themename, refreshes all widgets and emits a <<ThemeChanged>> event.

name: bbox
doc: Returns the bounding box (relative to the treeview widget’s window) of the specified item in the form (x, y, width, height).

name: column
doc: Query or modify the options for the specified column.

name: delete
doc: Delete all specified items and all their descendants.

name: detach
doc: Unlinks all of the specified items from the tree.

name: exists
doc: Returns True if the specified item is present in the tree, False otherwise.

name: focus
doc: If item is specified, sets the focus item to item. Otherwise, returns the current focus item, or ‘’ if there is none.

name: get_children
doc: Returns a tuple of children belonging to item.

name: heading
doc: Query or modify the heading options for the specified column.

name: identify
doc: Returns a description of the specified component under the point given by x and y, or the empty string if no such component is present at that position.

name: identify_column
doc: Returns the display column identifier of the cell at position x.

name: identify_element
doc: Returns the element at position x, y.

name: identify_region
doc: Returns one of:

name: identify_row
doc: Returns the item ID of the item at position y.

name: index
doc: Returns the integer index of item within its parent’s list of children.

name: insert
doc: Creates a new item and returns the item identifier of the newly created item.

name: item
doc: Query or modify the options for the specified item.

name: move
doc: Moves item to position index in parent’s list of children.

name: next
doc: Returns the identifier of item’s next sibling, or ‘’ if item is the last child of its parent.

name: parent
doc: Returns the ID of the parent of item, or ‘’ if item is at the top level of the hierarchy.

name: prev
doc: Returns the identifier of item’s previous sibling, or ‘’ if item is the first child of its parent.

name: reattach
doc: Moves item to position index in parent’s list of children.

name: see
doc: Ensure that item is visible.

name: selection
doc: Returns a tuple of selected items.

changed.text: selection() no longer takes arguments. For changing the selection state use the following selection methods.

name: selection_add
doc: Add items to the selection.

changed.text: items can be passed as separate arguments, not just as a single tuple.

name: selection_remove
doc: Remove items from the selection.

changed.text: items can be passed as separate arguments, not just as a single tuple.

name: selection_set
doc: items becomes the new selection.

changed.text: items can be passed as separate arguments, not just as a single tuple.

name: selection_toggle
doc: Toggle the selection state of each item in items.

changed.text: items can be passed as separate arguments, not just as a single tuple.

name: set
doc: With one argument, returns a dictionary of column/value pairs for the specified item. With two arguments, returns the current value of the specified column. With three arguments, sets the value of given column in given item to the specified value.

name: set_children
doc: Replaces item’s children with newchildren.

name: tag_bind
doc: Bind a callback for the given event sequence to the tag tagname. When an event is delivered to an item, the callbacks for each of the item’s tags option are called.

name: tag_configure
doc: Query or modify the options for the specified tagname.

name: tag_has
doc: If item is specified, returns True if the specified item has the given tagname and False otherwise. Otherwise, returns a tuple of all items that have the specified tag.

name: xview
doc: Query or modify horizontal position of the treeview.

name: yview
doc: Query or modify vertical position of the treeview.

name: Widget
doc: statespec will usually be a list or a tuple.

name: identify
doc: Returns the name of the element at position x y, or the empty string if the point does not lie within any element.

name: instate
doc: Test the widget’s state. If a callback is not specified, returns True if the widget state matches statespec and False otherwise. If callback is specified then it is called with args if widget state matches statespec.

name: state
doc: Modify or inquire widget state. If statespec is specified, sets the widget state according to it and return a new statespec indicating which flags were changed. If statespec is not specified, returns the currently enabled state flags.
